# Project Instructions

- Keep the project dependency-free unless the user asks otherwise.
- Preserve responsive behavior and accessible labels when changing the page.
- Keep course titles and level groupings in `programme-data.js`; render chapter-specific lesson content through the shared course page.
- Open `programmes.html` or `index.html` directly in a browser; no development server is required.
